title: Troubleshoot Noisy or Missing Alerts
objectives: Verify shared configuration, actual results and retained execution evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture supplies three explicit source_logs events and pauses the clock. Keep it paused while configuring; advance deliberately for scheduled work.
The supplied HTTP missing alert has a custom threshold too high to match the actual result. Advance one minute and inspect the successful search with no trigger.
Repair alert_condition to search count > 1. Enable digest suppression for 5m and retain the every-minute schedule, tracking and local notification. Save or reload native configuration.
Advance across two more minute boundaries. Verify one real trigger followed by a suppressed repeat. Diagnose the distinction between failed execution, unmatched condition and suppression.

hints: Inspect native configuration and the selected namespace. File edits need activation.
Check search results before diagnosing alert conditions or dashboard rendering.

references.purpose: Classic dashboard panels, searches and tokens
Studio definitions, data sources, visualizations and inputs
Alert conditions, scheduled execution and suppression

checks.label: Actual trigger, suppression and scheduler evidence
checks.title: HTTP missing alert

questions.prompt: What disposition describes the repeated trigger?

setup.text:
status=500 service=checkout latency=400
status=200 service=auth latency=25
status=500 service=checkout latency=300

[HTTP missing alert]
search=index=source_logs status=500 | stats count
enableSched=1
cron_schedule=* * * * *
dispatch.earliest_time=-15m
dispatch.latest_time=now
alert_condition=search count > 99
alert.digest_mode=1
alert.suppress=0
alert.suppress.period=5m
alert.track=1
alert.severity=4
actions=notification

feedback.success: Active source, actual result receipts and evidence satisfy the task.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect the missing outcome. Saving a definition alone does not execute its search.
